lines.en: Slices through the void with ethereal wings
Low growl echoes in the sky
Whisper of stars as it passes by
Scales glimmer in the night sky
Great dragon whispers through the void

lines.zh: 水晶洞顶擦过我的翼骨。
lines.en: The crystal ceiling grazes my wing bones.
I crush salt crystals underfoot as I advance.

lines.zh: 鳞片刮着迷宫石壁，火花四溅。
lines.en: My scales scrape the maze walls, sparks flying.

lines.zh: 我绕着天境浮岛低飞一圈。
lines.en: I circle the floating isles of the Aether.
Hears the whisper of the breeze

lines.zh: 我在长者遗迹上盘成一圈。
lines.en: I coil atop the elder ruins.

lines.zh: 灵魂尘落在我的背脊上。
lines.en: Soul dust settles along my spine.

lines.zh: 我数着浮岛，等第二阶段到来。
lines.en: I count the isles, waiting for my second phase.

lines.zh: 水晶映出我的两种模样。
lines.en: The crystals reflect both of my forms.
I look down at you from the crystal tower.

lines.zh: 我的瞳孔是两块打磨过的水晶。
lines.en: My pupils are two polished crystals.
Look up; I am inside your shadow.

lines.zh: 你的盔甲反光，晃到我的眼。
lines.en: Your armor glints and catches my eye.

lines.zh: 我在打量你先咬哪一块。
lines.en: I am deciding which part of you to bite first.

lines.zh: 你看我一眼，翅膀就僵了。
lines.en: One look at me, and your wings go stiff.

lines.zh: 别以为躲进迷宫我就找不到。
lines.en: Do not think the maze can hide you from me.

lines.zh: 你踩过的云，鳞片都记着。
lines.en: My scales remember the cloud you stepped on.

lines.zh: 天境的龙，从不低头看人。
lines.en: Aether dragons never look down on anyone.

lines.zh: 我可以看到你的恐惧在燃烧。
你身上有我猎物的味道。

lines.en: Come closer, and you'll turn to ash.

lines.zh: 你的恐惧让我更加饥饿。
天境的风向，把气味都送我。
lines.en: Aether's winds bring every scent to me.
My claws will tear you apart.
You're destined to be my meal.

lines.zh: 你的绝望将滋养我的力量。
lines.en: Your despair will fuel my power.

lines.zh: 你腰间那袋肉干，我闻到了。
lines.en: I smell the jerky at your belt.

lines.zh: 让开，我的翼展比这条廊宽。
lines.en: Move; my wingspan is wider than this hall.

lines.zh: 剑砍在龙鳞上，只溅火星。
lines.en: Your sword strikes my scales and only sparks fly.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片是天境的云做的。
lines.en: My scales are made of Aether cloud.
My power comes from the light.

lines.zh: 我们的结合将超越一切。

lines.en: Let us embrace the light together.

lines.zh: 你的存在让我更加强大。
与我结合，你将得到永生。
lines.en: Join me, and you'll find eternal life.

lines.zh: 与我在一起，你不会孤单。
lines.en: Be with me, and you'll never be alone.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀掠过，阴风随之而至。
lines.en: Its wings sweep by, carrying dark winds.

lines.zh: 我听到它的低吼，如同深渊之语。
lines.en: I hear its low growl, like words from the depths.

lines.zh: 水晶的碎光，我收进鳞缝。
lines.en: I tuck crystal glints under my scales.
The Aether's clouds hold me as I circle.

lines.zh: 它从远处低语，我感到一阵寒意。
lines.en: It whispers from afar, sending shivers down my spine.

lines.zh: 它的鳞片在月光下闪烁着邪恶的光芒。
lines.en: Its scales gleam with evil in the moonlight.

lines.zh: 它的声音回荡在整个天境。
lines.en: Its voice echoes through the Aether.

lines.zh: 它在寻找下一个牺牲品。
它的眼睛死死地盯着我。
它的鳞片在呼吸间变幻着颜色。
lines.en: Its scales shift color with each breath.

lines.zh: 我感受到它的怒火，即将发起攻击。
lines.en: I feel its rage, an attack is coming.

lines.zh: 它的爪子准备撕裂我的世界。
lines.en: Its claws prepare to tear my world.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛中燃起了怒火。
lines.en: Flames of fury burn in its eyes.

lines.zh: 它准备好了，随时准备爆发。
lines.en: It is ready, poised to erupt.

lines.zh: 它发出低沉的咆哮，准备战斗。
lines.en: It roars lowly, ready for battle.

lines.zh: 它的双翼展开，准备冲向我。
lines.en: Its wings spread, ready to charge.

lines.zh: 它的鳞片反射出敌意的光芒。
它开始加速，准备扑向我。
它的身形如幽灵般接近。
lines.en: Its form approaches like a ghost.

lines.zh: 它的呼吸变得急促，战斗一触即发。
第一阶段，先试试你的皮。
lines.en: Phase one: let me test your hide.
Your heartbeat is louder than the floating isles.
My breath is already aimed at you.

lines.zh: 你是今天第一个敢抬头的。
lines.en: You are the first today to dare look up.

lines.zh: 我把你标在迷宫地图上了。
lines.en: I have marked you on the maze map.

lines.zh: 第二阶段的账，先记你头上。
lines.en: Phase two's debt starts with you.

lines.zh: 它锁定我作为下一个猎物。
lines.en: It targets me as its next prey.

lines.zh: 它将我视为唯一的威胁。
lines.en: It sees me as its only threat.

lines.zh: 它的目光锁定在我身上。

lines.en: It is ready to attack me.

lines.zh: 它把注意力集中在了我身上。
它的爪子已经准备好，准备抓住我。
lines.en: Its claws are ready, poised to grab me.

lines.zh: 我压低翼尖，贴地向你滑。
lines.en: I lower my wingtips and skim toward you.

lines.zh: 水晶鳞片一片片竖了起来。
lines.en: My crystal scales rise one by one.

lines.zh: 喉咙里，火已经烧到牙关。
lines.en: In my throat, fire has reached my teeth.

lines.zh: 我还有第二个形态，别急。
lines.en: I have a second phase — don't rush.

lines.zh: 我绕着你飞，找最薄的地方。
lines.en: I circle you, hunting the thinnest spot.
Salt crystals crumble to powder under my claws.
Do not blink; I am changing my angle.

lines.zh: 咬合前，我会先吸一口气。
lines.en: Before I bite, I take one deep breath.

lines.zh: 翅膀扇下来的风带着火。
lines.en: The wind off my wings is carrying fire.
My tail hammer sweeps, and the isles shake!

lines.zh: 水晶尖爪，划开你的胸口！
lines.en: Crystal talons tear open your chest!
I dip my head, and dragonfire lands!
Wing bones slap your back with a dull crack!

lines.zh: 咬住你的护甲，连甲带肉！
lines.en: I bite your armor, plate and flesh together!

lines.zh: 第二阶段，可不是这样打的！
lines.en: Phase two does not fight like this!
Rips through space, nowhere to run!

lines.zh: 水晶深处，鳞光先亮起来。
lines.en: Deep in the crystal, scales light up first.

lines.zh: 迷宫尽头传来第一声龙吼。
lines.en: The first dragon roar comes from the maze's end.

lines.zh: 盐矿塌了一角，我钻出来。
lines.en: A salt mine corner collapses, and I crawl out.

lines.zh: 灵魂之尘聚成我的骨架。
lines.en: Soul dust gathers into my skeleton.
The seal on the elder ruins loosens.

lines.zh: 浮岛阴影里，我展开双翼。
lines.en: In the isles' shadow, I spread my wings.
I roll up over the Aether's edge.

lines.zh: 一声龙吟，云层裂成两半。
lines.en: One roar, and the clouds split in two.

lines.zh: 火焰烤着我自己的鳞，太烫了！
lines.en: The flames roast my own scales, too hot!
